name: Stage 45:2: Blommenhof to Hållet, etapp 45
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 45:2, Blommenhof to Hållet, etapp 45.
utilities: This is a short urban-edge connector from Blommenhof to Hållet/stage 45. Use Nyköping C/resecentrum, Blommenhof, hospital/Lasarettet, and the Hållet traffic-junction services for logistics rather than expecting wilderness facilities.
Blommenhof Hotell and nearby commercial services can provide food, toilets, or water only as customer/guest services; do not treat them as public trail utilities.
Frisksportartorpet/Stensborg is a useful rest/exercise/arboretum area and the official manager tip mentions a grill place there, but public access to water/toilets is not confirmed.
Lasarettet/Vårdcentral Åsidan, Trafikplats Hållet, and Nya Kyrkogården bus stops are useful access points; Nyköping C is the practical rail/bus anchor about a short walk from Blommenhof.
ICA Knuten/Oppeby and the Hållet traffic-junction food/fuel cluster are near-route resupply options, but they are urban detours rather than trail facilities.
waterSources: No verified free public potable-water point was found directly on the 1.9-2 km connector.
Frisksportartorpet event/club notes mention water by a sauna building, but this is not confirmed as an always-open public tap; mark as access-uncertain.
Use staffed/customer services such as Blommenhof, Nyköping C, Lasarettet/hospital area, Preem/Burger King, or Fåfängan when open. Natural water in Hållet/Nyköpingsån is not potable.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.
Official Sörmlandsleden lists this as stage 45:2, Blommenhof to Hållet, 2 km. The local route geometry is about 1.94 km and matches the official start/end well.

Naming/topology is messy: OSM/Naturkartan and some third-party sources often discuss the larger Kungsladugården-Hållet connector as 44:2, while the current official site exposes the Blommenhof-Hållet connector as 45:2. Keep this section as a short connector into stage 45.
Route character: short forest/urban connector via Frisksportartorpet/Stensborg, road crossings toward Katrineholm/Eskilstuna, E4 tunnel, and Hållet-Marieberg-Stenbro reserve paths.

Hållet-Marieberg-Stenbro reserve rules: dogs/pets leashed, no camping or camp activity without Nyköping municipality permission, fires only at prepared fireplaces, and no damage to trees/dead wood/rock/stone/cultural remains. Nyköping adopted a new reserve decision on 2025-11-11, but it was appealed; visitor C-rules still apply while the older decision otherwise remains in force.

Nyköping local public-place camping rules are restrictive: do not treat Blommenhof, Hållet, station-area parks, or urban public places as legal camping spots without a permit or a specifically designated campsite.

Official 45:2 page showed no current fault reports during this research pass. Nearby/relevant caveats: Nyköping resecentrum works can alter station-area approaches, and Trafikverket currently lists E4 Blommenhov bridge construction start as 2028; no current closure for the 45:2 E4 tunnel was found.

Fire status is dynamic: Sörmlandskustens räddningstjänst showed no formal fire ban during the research pass, but Länsstyrelsen still displayed fire-risk guidance. In the reserve, use only prepared fireplaces, and avoid all fires during a skärpt eldningsförbud.
